title: Align webhook idempotency/verification per route
goal: Certify every enabled launch webhook for signature verification, atomic idempotency, safe retry and replay behavior, and redacted failures while gating deferred providers
acceptance_criteria: Stripe, ticketing, marketplace, Supabase notification, and every other enabled launch webhook verifies provider identity before side effects
Enabled webhook routes use durable atomic receipt claims, duplicate acknowledgements, replay-safe completion, and safe retry semantics
Invalid payloads and internal failures expose no secrets or sensitive provider data
Advanced music, institutional, licensing, rights-admin, and other deferred provider routes are disabled unless separately certified
Focused contract, replay, persistence-failure, and deployed staging tests pass

evidence: Feature-tier route contract suite passed: 1 file, 8 tests.
Focused ESLint passed for all eight changed webhook/processor implementation paths plus the INTG-006 contract test.
Narrow scoped TypeScript project check passed with zero diagnostics across the eight changed implementation files; the temporary .codex-intg-006-tsconfig.json was removed after verification.
Changed-path git diff --check passed for the eight implementation paths and the INTG-006 contract test path.
No production code or database migrations changed in this verification-only slice.

progress.summary: Focused launch-hardening verification passed for advanced webhook gating and redacted marketplace failure handling.
completed: Ticketing webhook claims ticket_stripe_webhook_events after signature verification regardless of FEATURE_TICKETING_V2.
Ticketing webhook claim persistence failures now throw so the route returns its existing 500 retry response instead of processing unclaimed events.
Added focused contract coverage for feature-flag-independent claims and fail-closed ledger failures.
Music royalty webhook claims its endpoint event ledger before instruction lookup or status processing; duplicate claims return a duplicate acknowledgement without side effects.
Music royalty webhook now fails closed on claim, lookup, metadata, payout-status, and completion persistence errors, with focused duplicate and claim-failure coverage.
Marketplace Shopify and Printful handlers now require stable provider event identity, claim provider receipts before side effects, and record completion only after all handler writes succeed.

Music marketplace, institutional, licensing, and rights-admin partner handlers now use atomic insert claims, duplicate-safe acknowledgements, explicit invalid-payload responses, and checked handler/completion persistence; provider-specific signature adapters and unsigned sandbox flags remain intact.
Supabase notification delivery now uses the existing delivery log for duplicate suppression and timing-safe secret comparison.
Marketplace Stripe completion-update failures now fail the event and enter the existing failed-event path.
Advanced music, institutional, licensing, rights-admin, and music royalty webhook routes fail closed unless FEATURE_AUDIT_ADVANCED_WEBHOOKS_APPROVED is explicitly enabled.
Marketplace Stripe webhook returns a generic retryable failure and persists only an internal failure marker rather than provider or database error text.
next_steps: Database hosted reconciliation and staging replay evidence remain required.
blockers: Hosted Supabase receipt schemas and notification claim uniqueness remain unverified.
